parsed.name: HTTP规则推送器
parsed.description: 用于通过HTTP向实验室数据处理集群提交规则和帧级任务的软件组件，常见于显微成像等实验数据的自动化处理流程中。
parsed.description_en: A software component for submitting rules and frame-level tasks over HTTP to a laboratory data-processing cluster, commonly used in automated workflows for microscopy and other experimental data analysis.

actions.description: 通过HTTP提交处理规则到集群。
actions.description_en: Submit a processing rule to the cluster over HTTP.

actions.description: 为各个数据帧生成并提交任务定义。
actions.description_en: Generate and submit task definitions for individual data frames.

actions.description: 清理已提交任务相关的临时状态或资源。
actions.description_en: Clean up temporary state or resources associated with submitted tasks.
